name: Jacob Cook
tagline: I engineer Sigma coverage, SIEM tuning, and automation so noisy telemetry turns into triage paths analysts can repeat.
heroGreeting: Detection engineer building reliable triage from noisy data.
heroSubtitle: Sigma rules, SIEM hardening, identity detections, and SOAR-style orchestration.
bio: Detection and security automation engineer focused on reducing alert noise, closing coverage gaps, and building repeatable triage paths. My public detection work includes behavioral Sigma rules with KV store enrichment and false-positive tuning, Okta identity threat detections, SOAR-style orchestration that cuts manual response steps, and network behavior analysis that catches C2 beaconing and exfiltration patterns. Based in California. Outside of work I enjoy camping, mountain biking, and time with my dogs.
targetRoles: Open to: Detection Engineer, Threat Hunter, Security Automation Engineer, Vulnerability Management, Tier 2+ SOC. Sacramento or remote.

experience.title: MS Cybersecurity Graduate Student
experience.description: MS Cybersecurity (competency-based): network defense, incident response, security architecture, and hands-on labs across SIEM, logging, and system hardening. Coursework and labs connected to public detection and automation work, with emphasis on detection coverage, alert quality, and triage paths.

experience.title: Security & Detection Projects (Open Source)
experience.description: Public detection and automation portfolio across SIEM, identity, cloud, and network security. Built behavioral Sigma detection pack for Stryker/Intune MDM attack with KV store enrichment and baseline-aware thresholds. Okta detection engine with false-positive tuning (3 benign use cases per detection). SOAR-style orchestration automating alert intake and response. Network behavior analyzer detecting C2 beaconing via behavioral baselines. Wazuh SIEM stack with rule tuning that tightened noisy coverage. Each project includes detection logic, false-positive analysis, and repeatable triage paths. Code at github.com/jacobdcook.

experience.title: Warehouse Operations – Engineering & Facilities Support
experience.description: Supported Engineering and Facilities in a high-throughput warehouse: kept industrial and material-handling systems available, diagnosed hardware and integration failures quickly, and used root cause analysis and change control to reduce repeat outages and downtime. Monitoring, diagnostics, sensor-to-server validation, and change management aligned to operational and enterprise standards.
